_README: CANONICAL set_limit / clear_limit WIRE CONTRACT (Task P8). This file is the single source of truth for the per-app-limit poll-command shape. A BYTE-IDENTICAL copy lives in the iOS repo at 'Evlin iOSTests/Fixtures/app_limit_wire.json'. BOTH copies MUST stay in sync: the backend emission test (tests/test_app_limit_wire_contract.py) asserts queue_app_limit_rule/queue_clear_app_limit_rule emit a payload whose key-shape matches the 'set_limit'/'clear_limit' objects below; the iOS decode test (AppLimitWireContractTests) decodes these same objects through PollCommandDTO -> CommandPoller.lockCommand. If either side renames a key, its contract test breaks. schedule.starts_at/ends_at are 'HH:mm' strings ('00:00'->minute 0, '23:59'->minute 1439) because iOS parses them via minutesSinceMidnight. duration_minutes is ALWAYS null (budget lives in limit.daily_budget_minutes).
